extracted.name: Make-Ahead Manicotti
extracted.description: This make-ahead manicotti is stuffed with a tasty blend of spinach, Parmesan, and mozzarella, and topped with store-bought spaghetti sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instruction_lines: Mix ricotta cheese and eggs together in a medium bowl until blended. Stir in spinach, mozzarella cheese, 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese, sugar, salt, and pepper. Stuff mixture into uncooked pasta shells.

Pour 1/2 cup spaghetti sauce into a medium baking dish; spread to cover the bottom. Arrange stuffed shells in a single layer over sauce. Pour remaining sauce over shells. Cover and chill in the refrigerator, 8 hours to overnight.
When ready to bake, preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Remove shells from the refrigerator.
Bake, covered, in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Uncover, sprinkle with remaining Parmesan cheese, and bake for 15 more minutes.
